privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use RECIST 1.1 standards. The CT scan is located at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/oncology_ct/. The soft tissue window settings should be Window Width (WW) 400 and Window Level (WL) 50. Two distinct lesions must be measured. The final outputs must be recist_lesion1.png, recist_lesion2.png, and recist_report.txt in the /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ directory.
